title: fix(metadata-protocol): the seed save door refuses an unknown object; the probe names a missing object
body:
Fixes #34864

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
File-surface: as claimed (claim amended in comment 7003076381): packages/metadata-protocol/src/{protocol-save-door-refusals,protocol-save,protocol,build-probes,build-probes.user-text}.ts and their two test files, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-object-unknown-refused.ts, packages/objectql/src/{protocol-meta,publish-package-drafts-seed-receipt-counts,publish-seed-receipt-landed-ids}.test.ts, .changeset/34864-seed-unknown-object-save-door.md
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md (the seed field table and the save notes: a runtime-saved seed must name an object that exists, a draft object is enough for a draft seed), skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json (an eval that saves a seed naming an unknown object and expects the 422)

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：在搭建对话或接口里保存一份示例数据时，如果它指向一个根本不存在的对象，现在会当场被拒并说出那个对象名；发布后的检查提示也不再让人"重新发布"，而是让人改对象名或先建对象。
2. 为什么做：质检发现智能体和接口作者拼错对象名时，示例数据被静默保存，发布显示成功却一条记录都没有，提示还指错了方向。
3. 出错会怎样：若判断有误，作者保存示例数据会被误拒；回退本改动即可恢复原状，已存的数据不受影响。
4. 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Save door** (`seedExternalIdSaveRefusal`, now also asked with `door: 'save'` from `saveMetaItem`): a seed whose `object` is resolved by no pending batch object, no object draft (on a draft save), no registered object and no stored or code-defined object (`readMetaItem`) is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA`, one finding at `object` naming the seed, the object and the fix. The unknown test follows the permission-set grant refusal: a registry without `getObject` refuses nothing; a name two packages hold counts as held; a dependency package's object answers the same registry read. `migrate-stored` re-saves are not judged.
- **Unchanged by design (ruling zone, #27393):** the publish promotion and the restore doors pass no `door` and still leave such a seed to the load; a draft seed whose object is a draft is still judged at its publish.
- **Probe** (`build-probes.ts`): when a published seed's object read throws AND the engine answers its registered objects (`getSchema`) with none for that name AND no published object of the name is held, `seed_not_applied` takes the new cause `missing`: `message`/`fix` name the missing object; `userMessage` (all 11 platform locales) says correct the object or create and publish it. Every other read failure keeps `unreadable`.
- **ADR-0087 ledger entry** `seed-object-unknown-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-object-unknown-refused.ts`, data only: surface, replacement, reason, acceptance criteria). The changeset registers it; no other open PR or main carries that id.
- Stale fixtures (consequence of the narrowing): two objectql suites stage a missing-object seed draft to test the publish load; they now stage it at rest through the `migrate-stored` re-save. `protocol-meta.test.ts` registers the object its brand-new seed names. The old metadata-protocol control "an object neither registered nor drafted is not judged here" pinned exactly the removed branch and is replaced by the new describe.

## Tests

- New top-level describe in `protocol.seed-external-id-refusal.test.ts` (shared harness): unknown object refused in draft-into-package / draft-no-package / publish saves (code, status, path, first clause, fix tail, nothing stored or loaded); a publish save whose object is only a draft refused; controls: registered object 200, same-package object draft 200, `migrate-stored` 200, publish promotion of a planted draft still publishes, restore door resolves.
- `build-probes-user-message.test.ts`: the `missing` case in the per-locale battery, the en/zh sentences as written, agent message/fix, and three `unreadable` controls (object registered but read fails; engine without `getSchema`; a published object of the name held).

## Acceptance notes

- The restore door does not judge the object's existence (same as the publish promotion). Its docblock in `protocol.ts` (`refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`) does not list the seed refusals at all, before or after this change.
